task: U16 t3 prototype (offline, no deploy): in the runtime JAR make onStart/onResume (+ executePendingTransactions) advance synchronously within the launch transaction (AOSP handleLaunchActivity order) to fix fd-breezyweather's async-lifecycle lateinit crash. Patch + design note. Regression risk: scan all U13 stage-A lit keys' hilogs for 'onCreate-posted main-thread callback runs before RESUMED' (risk set); per-key judge; predicted moves (breezyweather 1).

fix.effect: launch transaction cycles onCreate -> onStart synchronously (StartActivityItem.getTargetState()==ON_START); onStart runs FragmentController dispatchActivityCreated -> Fragment.onCreateView, assigning lateinit views before the Looper processes any onCreate-posted runnable (AOSP handleLaunchActivity order).
fix.onResume_unchanged: onResume stays phase-2 (OH FOREGROUND callback -> ResumeActivityItem cycles ON_START->ON_RESUME); the G2.14m AMS FOREGROUNDING handshake (resume-at-launch raced AMS INACTIVE -> rc=22) is untouched
fix.why_onStart_not_onResume: ON_RESUME at launch reintroduces the rc=22 AMS race AND addViews the decor before the OH surface is ready (empty-surface white); ON_START only inflates (surface-free) = exactly what onCreateView needs, minimum deviation

aosp_reference: ActivityThread.handleLaunchActivity: launch ClientTransaction (LaunchActivityItem + lifecycle request) -> TransactionExecutor executeCallbacks(onCreate) + executeLifecycleState(cycleToPath to final state); cold launch reaches ON_RESUME so onCreate->onStart->onResume run in one main-thread transaction; Fragment.onCreateView runs during onStart.

regression_risk.heuristic_gap_activity_upper_bound: 63/121 lit keys have main-thread app activity in the performCreate->RESUMED gap, but this OVER-COUNTS (catches inline onCreate work, unaffected) and MISSES fd-breezyweather (its posted callback surfaced only via the crash); NOT used as the risk count
regression_risk.risk_set_note: the 4 native-engine lit keys = the only on-board watch items; even they expected benign (SurfaceView surface is created at window-add=onResume, not onStart -> availability unchanged). 118 jvm = benign (onStart = surface-free inflation). 0 surface-dependent.
regression_risk.safety_argument: the fix RESTORES stock AOSP onCreate->onStart synchrony (route-A's two-phase deferral is the deviation); every app here lights on stock Android so tolerates it; onResume + AMS handshake untouched. Only reliance on the route-A-specific async gap (a latent bug) could change -> none observed.
regression_risk.one_protocol_point_to_confirm_on_board: OH maps onStart <-> onWindowStageCreate; onStart now precedes OH's onWindowStageCreate callback (expected safe: onStart doesn't touch the OH window stage; verify on board)

this_rounds_rule: Fix the ordering where AOSP does: advance to ON_START inside the launch transaction (restore onCreate->onStart synchrony), not resume-at-launch (which reintroduces the AMS rc=22 race + empty-surface risk). Bound regression risk by mechanism+stack, not a log heuristic that can't separate posted from inline work; here the behaviourally-relevant risk set is the 4 native-engine lit keys and the AOSP-restore argument predicts 0 lit regressions.
